title: Can I BEAT Stockfih?
summary: 'Stockfih' meme: an engine with 8 of Stockfish's 9 letters, so it plays 8 Stockfish moves and then every 9th move is played by Martin (random-ish 250 bot). Tony (White) tries to survive 8 moves then exploit the Martin move. Moves are counted on screen. He ultimately loses to a triple-battery checkmate.
rules: Bot cycle: moves 1-8 played at full Stockfish strength, move 9 played by Martin (weak), repeating every 9 moves.
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfih (video ended in a loss).
